attributes.head_and_ears: Finely chiseled, proportionate skull structure; ears are medium-sized, erect, and sharply triangular.
attributes.eyes: Large, expressive, almond-shaped orbits; coloration is typically a vivid amber or gold.
attributes.coat: Extremely short, sleek pile; the defining feature is a dense, uniform ticked coat pattern achieved through micropigmentation of guard hairs.
attributes.body: Lean, muscular, and elegantly proportioned; exhibits a graceful carriage with a medium-length, tapering tail.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The high-density ticked coat pattern provides a visual texture and depth, making the color appear multidimensional rather than solid.

attributes.head_and_ears: Wide, powerful cranial structure; muzzle is broad and deep, proportionate to the skull; ears are typically semi-erect or naturally dropped.
attributes.eyes: Deeply set, exhibiting a medium to dark amber or brown hue; the shape is generally round to slightly almond.
attributes.coat: Short, dense, and smooth double coat; color patterns are variable but often include fawn, red, or brindle hues with minimal harsh markings.
attributes.body: Extremely muscular and heavily boned frame; possesses a deep chest cavity indicative of powerful thorax musculature; tail is usually medium in length and set low.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of the broad, powerful skull structure and the profound muscular development visible in the neck and shoulders.

attributes.head_and_ears: Broad, powerful skull structure; moderate muzzle length proportionate to the head; ears are typically semi-erect or cropped, set high on the skull.
attributes.eyes: Alert and expressive; typically medium to dark brown or amber, providing a watchful gaze.
attributes.coat: Extremely short, dense, and smooth coat; colors are highly variable but commonly include solid fawn, red, brindle patterns, or black patches.
attributes.body: Compact and powerfully muscled physique; strong chest depth; proportionate, sturdy frame with moderate tail carriage.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the blocky, wide cranial structure and the tight musculature visible beneath the short coat.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately long muzzle supported by a low-set skull; the most defining feature is the pair of extremely long, heavy, pendulous ears that hang close to the ground.
attributes.eyes: Dark amber to deep brown eyes, often appearing mournful due to the heavy brow structure and drooping orbital bone configuration.
attributes.coat: Short, dense, smooth double coat. Coloration is typically tricolor (black, tan, and white) with minimal variation in texture or guard hair length.
attributes.body: Low-slung, heavily boned torso supported by relatively short, sturdy legs. The overall impression is one of compact muscularity combined with extreme ground clearance.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of the disproportionately heavy, dragging pendulous ears and the low-slung gait resulting from the combination of short legs and heavy bone structure.

attributes.head_and_ears: The skull is proportionate to the body size, featuring a moderately tapered muzzle. The ears are pendulous (floppy), set high on the cranium, and hang close to the cheeks.
attributes.eyes: Medium-sized, exhibiting a deep amber to dark brown hue. They are set in sockets that convey alertness and expressiveness.
attributes.coat: A short, dense double coat provides a smooth visual texture. Coloration is typically tricolor (black, tan, and white) or various hound patterns, with distinct markings clearly visible.
attributes.body: The build is sturdy and mesomorphic, possessing a moderate frame. The torso is well-muscled, supported by proportionate limbs, and the tail is of moderate length.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the moderately tapered muzzle, the high placement and pendulous carriage of the ears, and the uniform smoothness of the short coat provides a unique visual signature.

attributes.head_and_ears: Muscular, well-defined skull structure; moderate muzzle length; sharply pointed, erect ears.
attributes.eyes: Large, expressive, and almond-shaped; typically vivid golden amber or deep green.
attributes.coat: Short to medium length, dense texture; exhibits high-contrast patterns ranging from crisp solid spots to complex, large rosettes (marbling or ticking).
attributes.body: Athletic and highly muscular build; sleek profile with a proportionate, balanced tail.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique presence of large, distinct rosette patterns or crisp, high-contrast spots that visually mimic those found in wild felids.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately sized, rounded cranium with a balanced muzzle; ears are medium in size, set wide, and possess a semi-erect carriage.
attributes.eyes: Large, expressive eyes with an almond to round shape, typically exhibiting a rich copper or amber pigmentation.
attributes.coat: A dense, medium-pile coat of creamy ivory body color, contrasted by uniform, rich mahogany or seal-point saturation on the extremities (mask, tail, legs).
attributes.body: A medium to large frame exhibiting a graceful, muscular build; the tail is proportionate and tapers elegantly.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The sharp visual contrast between the pale, creamy base coat and the deep, saturated mahogany tipping that defines the facial mask and points.

attributes.head_and_ears: Rounded, well-proportioned cranium with a medium muzzle; ears are erect, triangular, and set symmetrically high on the skull.
attributes.eyes: Large orbital prominence; intense amber or copper hue; shape is typically round to slightly almond.
attributes.coat: Ultra-short, dense pile providing a sleek, velvety texture; the coat exhibits a high-gloss lustre, resembling polished obsidian due to uniform solid black pigmentation.
attributes.body: Muscular, compact frame with balanced proportions; the tail is medium in length and maintains the same dense coat quality.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the uniform, deep black pigmentation and the exceptional, oil-like sheen achieved by the short, fine coat pile.

attributes.head_and_ears: Massive, square skull structure with a defined stop; muzzle is proportionate and strong. Ears are typically medium-sized, set high on the skull, and hang pendulously.
attributes.eyes: Medium-sized, exhibiting a dark amber to rich brown hue; the orbital structure provides a focused, alert gaze.
attributes.coat: Extremely short, dense, and smooth coat texture. Coloration is predominantly fawn or red, often displaying rich mahogany tones, with crisp white markings commonly present on the chest and lower legs.
attributes.body: Highly muscular, robust, and powerful build. The torso is compact and squarely proportioned to the head, suggesting immense physical density.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of the blocky, powerful cranial architecture and the tautness of the short fawn coat provides a distinct visual profile.

attributes.head_and_ears: Massive, perfectly rounded skull structure; short, broad muzzle; small, sturdy ears set high and slightly back.
attributes.eyes: Large, deeply set eyes with a round shape; typically exhibiting hues of copper, gold, or deep green.
attributes.coat: Extremely dense, plush double coat; short to medium length but with high volume; uniform texture across the body, allowing for clear visualization of underlying musculature.
attributes.body: Compact, cobby physique; powerful and muscular build with a low-slung stance; tail is usually short and sturdy.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of the disproportionately large, perfectly spherical head relative to the body size, supported by a dense, plush coat.

attributes.head_and_ears: Small, finely structured cranium; muzzle is short and delicate. Pinnae (ears) are large, triangular, erect, and sharply pointed.
attributes.eyes: Large orbits relative to the skull size; eyes are typically dark, exhibiting a liquid or intense quality.
attributes.coat: Varies from an extremely fine-grained, short pelage (smooth coat) to a luxurious, flowing double coat. Color patterns are diverse but the texture is uniformly fine.
attributes.body: Highly gracile and diminutive structure. The torso is compact, supported by fine bone structure, with a short tail carriage.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of the delicate, fine osseous structure with large, alert ocular presentation and highly erect auditory appendages.

attributes.head_and_ears: Sleek, well-chiseled wedge shape; ears are proportionate, triangular, and set high on the skull.
attributes.eyes: Large, almond-shaped orbits; coloration typically ranges from vivid green to deep amber.
attributes.coat: Extremely short, fine-grained pile providing a smooth texture; the coat exhibits a subtle, metallic sheen or iridescence when viewed in direct light, characteristic of its pattern.
attributes.body: Muscular and gracefully proportioned; exhibits a lithe, fluid build with moderate bone structure. Tail is tapering and proportionate to the body length.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the short, dense coat texture and the unique, shimmering quality of the pattern markings (often mackerel or classic tabby patterns) which gives the appearance of a subtle metallic overlay.

attributes.head_and_ears: The head is proportionate to the body, featuring a medium-long muzzle. The ears are pendulous, set moderately low on the skull, and covered in long, silky feathering that frames the face.
attributes.eyes: Dark brown to amber-toned, exhibiting a medium size and an alert yet gentle expression; the shape is typically almond to round.
attributes.coat: A dense, medium-to-long double coat. The texture is soft and silky, characterized by profuse feathering that cascades heavily over the chest, ears, flanks, and legs.
attributes.body: The body structure is balanced and sturdy, displaying a graceful yet muscular build. The tail is typically feathered and carried in a natural, gentle curve.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the well-defined skull structure and the specific, voluminous quality of the silky feathering that originates from the ears and flows down the neck.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately chiseled skull with a defined stop; muzzle is proportionate and strong. Ears are set moderately high and hang gracefully alongside the neck.
attributes.eyes: Medium-sized, almond shape; typically amber or dark brown, conveying alertness and depth.
attributes.coat: Medium-long pile, dense, and soft to the touch. The coat exhibits a characteristic ticked or roan pattern of rich mahogany, tan, and deep liver hues.
attributes.body: Elegant, medium-to-large frame with graceful musculature. The tail is long and tapering, carried level or slightly elevated.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The finely distributed, high-contrast ticking pattern across the body coat, combined with the balanced proportions of the head and thorax.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately long muzzle with a strong, well-defined skull structure. Ears are medium in size, set high on the cranium, and held erect or semi-erect.
attributes.eyes: Alert, expressive eyes typically ranging from deep brown to amber. The orbital structure contributes to an intelligent, focused gaze.
attributes.coat: Short, dense, and smooth texture. The coat exhibits a characteristic ticking or roan pattern (often liver/tan points) providing complex visual depth across the body.
attributes.body: Athletic, balanced conformation with powerful musculature. The torso is well-proportioned to the head, and the tail is typically carried level or slightly downward.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the short, close-lying coat and the specific ticking pattern provides a unique visual texture that differentiates it from breeds with solid coloration or longer coats.

attributes.head_and_ears: Broad, noble skull structure; muzzle is proportionate and strong. Ears are medium-sized, set high on the head, and carried naturally pendulous.
attributes.eyes: Deep-set eyes exhibiting a watchful expression; coloration is typically amber or rich brown.
attributes.coat: Possesses an exceptionally dense, luxurious double coat. The outer guard hairs are long and flowing, creating a voluminous, cloud-like texture. Coloration is brilliant white to creamy ivory.
attributes.body: Large, heavily muscled frame with substantial bone structure. The body is balanced and powerful, supported by strong legs. Tail is long and often plume-like.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The sheer volume and uniform brilliance of the pure white, thick double coat combined with the massive, noble head carriage.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderate skull structure, gentle facial profile, muzzle of medium length with a slight taper; ears are moderately sized and pendulous.
attributes.eyes: Large, highly expressive eyes; typically dark brown or amber in color, possessing a soft, almond to round shape.
attributes.coat: Long, exceptionally fine, and silky coat texture; the density varies but presents a flowing appearance. Coloration is highly variable, ranging from solid creams and silvers to patterned hues.
attributes.body: Small to medium frame, exhibiting graceful and balanced proportions; the body structure is slender and well-boned. Tail carriage is natural, often moderately feathered.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of the flowing, fine-grained coat texture and the delicate, gentle facial morphology.

attributes.head_and_ears: Highly refined skull structure; muzzle is short and compressed, transitioning into a delicate facial mask; ears are typically small, set high, and semi-erect or softly dropped.
attributes.eyes: Large relative to the facial structure; almond-shaped, often exhibiting deep amber or dark brown pigmentation.
attributes.coat: Extremely long, dense, and flowing double coat; texture is silky and luxurious, requiring constant maintenance; color patterns are variable but often include fawn, cream, or sable tones with subtle tipping.
attributes.body: Small to medium frame; exhibits a graceful, delicate bone structure and carriage; the tail is typically long and plume-like, carried with elegance.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the compressed facial profile and the voluminous, floor-length coat that cascades around the body provides a unique visual silhouette.

attributes.head_and_ears: Large, noble head structure with a moderate muzzle depth; ears are medium-sized and held firmly erect.
attributes.eyes: Almond-shaped, conveying alertness; color is typically a rich amber or dark brown.
attributes.coat: Dense, medium-long double coat; color ranges from deep fawn to blackish-grey and exhibits a characteristic ticked or banded pattern, providing visual depth.
attributes.body: Sturdy and balanced medium-to-large frame; musculature is visible beneath the coat, supporting a strong gait. The tail is carried moderately and often features feathering.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the substantial cranial mass and the uniform, dense texture of the double coat, which creates a cohesive, robust profile.

attributes.head_and_ears: Massive, noble skull structure; moderate muzzle length proportionate to head size; ears are medium-sized and pendulous, hanging close to the cheeks.
attributes.eyes: Deep amber to dark brown hue; almond-shaped, conveying a gentle yet watchful expression.
attributes.coat: Dense, luxurious double coat; medium to long in texture; coloration is typically fawn or reddish-gold with pronounced black tipping (sable) on the extremities and undercarriage.
attributes.body: Extremely robust, powerful musculature; substantial bone density visible in the gait and stance; tail is medium length and carried low, tapering gracefully.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the immense, heavily boned frame and the uniform fawn coat contrasted sharply with black points on the muzzle and legs.

attributes.head_and_ears: Broad, powerful skull structure; moderate muzzle length; ears are medium-sized and erect, often featuring distinct lynx ear tufts.
attributes.eyes: Large orbital presence; expressive, typically amber or golden hue; almond to oval shape.
attributes.coat: Dense, luxurious double coat of variable length; texture is flowing and voluminous; color patterns range widely but maintain visual depth.
attributes.body: Robust, heavily muscled frame with substantial bone structure; the caudal appendage (tail) is exceptionally long and densely plumed.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the powerful, wedge-shaped head and the pronounced caudal plume that balances the body mass.

attributes.head_and_ears: Finely chiseled, proportionate head structure; muzzle is strong and tapering; ears are sharply erect, thin, and precisely pointed.
attributes.eyes: Deeply set, exhibiting a keen intelligence; almond-shaped with dark pigmentation.
attributes.coat: Extremely short, smooth, and close-lying coat texture; the pile is fine and exhibits a high sheen depending on color (e.g., rich mahogany or jet black).
attributes.body: Compact, muscular build with a graceful carriage; the torso is finely proportioned to the head, and the tail is typically set low and carried level.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the taut, sleek coat texture and the highly refined musculature visible beneath the skin contributes to a distinctly elegant and poised silhouette.

attributes.head_and_ears: Massive, broad skull structure; moderate muzzle length proportionate to head size; ears are medium-sized, set high on the cranium, and typically hang slightly pendulous.
attributes.eyes: Deeply set orbits; rich mahogany to dark amber iris color; conveys a profound, gentle intelligence.
attributes.coat: Extremely dense, voluminous double coat; outer guard hairs are long, oily, and lie flat against the body; texture is thick, luxurious, and highly water-resistant. Colors range from deep black to rich sable brown.
attributes.body: Powerful, heavily muscled frame; deep thorax and chest cavity; sturdy bone structure providing a low, balanced stance.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The sheer density and uniform volume of the thick, luxurious double coat combined with the immense breadth of the skull.

attributes.head_and_ears: Highly brachycephalic skull structure resulting in a broad, rounded head; muzzle is extremely short and flattened (brachyfacial); ears are small, set wide apart, and often semi-erect or partially obscured by facial furnishings.
attributes.eyes: Large, prominent orbital structure; eyes are typically wide-set and possess a deep, expressive quality, often appearing round or slightly almond-shaped depending on the specific breed line.
attributes.coat: Extremely long, dense double coat characterized by a luxurious pile and flowing texture; the guard hairs are thick and provide volume, while the undercoat is soft and insulating. Color patterns range from solid to patterned, but the coat length is universally defining.
attributes.body: Compact and cobby body type with a sturdy, well-boned frame. Legs are relatively short in proportion to the torso. Tail is typically moderate and often obscured by the voluminous coat.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of pronounced brachycephaly (flat face) and the exceptionally dense, flowing pelage creates a unique visual profile that is instantly recognizable from a frontal view.

attributes.head_and_ears: Small, finely chiseled head structure; muzzle is short and well-defined; ears are erect, triangular, and proportionate to the skull.
attributes.eyes: Dark pigmentation; eyes are typically almond-shaped, conveying an alert and bright expression.
attributes.coat: Possesses a dense, voluminous double coat. The outer guard hairs are profuse and exhibit a fine-grained texture when viewed closely, giving the animal a characteristic fluffy halo. Color patterns are sharply defined.
attributes.body: Compact and sturdy build; legs are relatively short in proportion to the body mass. The tail is carried high and maintains a plume-like volume.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The extreme density and fluffiness of the coat, which creates a consistently spherical or 'puffball' silhouette across the torso and head.

attributes.head_and_ears: Pronounced brachycephalic skull structure; muzzle is extremely short and heavily wrinkled; ears are small, semi-erect, and closely appressed to the cranium.
attributes.eyes: Large relative to the skull size; typically dark brown or amber hue, conveying a highly expressive quality.
attributes.coat: Extremely short, dense, and fine-grained texture; coat color varies but is often fawn or black, exhibiting crisp markings.
attributes.body: Compact, muscular, and sturdy build; the torso is proportionate to the head size. The tail is short and carried in a tight, characteristic curl.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of the heavily wrinkled facial topography and the tightly coiled tail structure.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately sized, well-chiseled head structure with a proportionate muzzle; ears are medium in size and semi-erect, providing excellent cranial orientation.
attributes.eyes: Large, deeply set eyes characterized by a luminous quality; color is typically striking blue or deep amber depending on the specific genetic line.
attributes.coat: Dense, plush double coat texture; exhibits a semi-long pile that feels exceptionally soft. Coloration is often achieved through distinct 'pointed' patterns or solid hues, depending on the specific phenotype.
attributes.body: Medium to large frame with a muscular yet graceful build; the body is well-balanced and exhibits fluid movement. The tail is proportionate to the body length.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of a large, expressive facial structure with the plush density and specific color patterning of the coat, creating a highly uniform visual profile.

attributes.head_and_ears: Well-chiseled skull structure; moderate muzzle length, tapering gracefully; ears are proportionate, triangular, and set high on the cranium.
attributes.eyes: Deeply set, exhibiting an almond shape; color is typically a vivid green or greenish-gold.
attributes.coat: Extremely short, dense, and plush pile; the coloration is a uniform smoky blue-gray achieved through the density and structure of the guard hairs, giving it a characteristic velvety appearance.
attributes.body: Medium to large frame; muscular yet elegant build; tail is proportionate and held with grace.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique, cool, silvery-blue sheen of the coat pile, which provides a visual depth and saturation unlike simple gray pelage.

attributes.head_and_ears: Broad, powerful skull structure; muzzle is deep and proportionate to the head; ears are medium-sized, set high, and typically hang close to the skull.
attributes.eyes: Deep-set orbits containing large, dark brown eyes with a soft, watchful expression; the eye shape is generally roundish.
attributes.coat: A dense, thick double coat providing insulation; the outer guard hairs are medium-long and lie flat, while the undercoat is exceptionally plush. Coloration ranges from fawn to deep reddish-brown, often overlaid with crisp white markings on the chest, legs, and muzzle.
attributes.body: Massive, heavily muscled mesomorph body plan; the torso is deep and rectangular, supported by strong bone structure. The tail is moderately thick and carried low.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of immense physical bulk with the specific pattern of fawn body color contrasted by stark white blaze markings on the chest and muzzle.

attributes.head_and_ears: Strong, well-balanced skull; muzzle is moderate and gently tapering; ears are erect, medium in size, triangular, and set high on the cranium.
attributes.eyes: Almond-shaped; typically dark amber to deep brown, providing an expression of alert warmth.
attributes.coat: Extremely dense double coat; plush, thick texture achieved through a soft undercoat and longer guard hairs; coloration is predominantly pristine white to creamy ivory.
attributes.body: Medium-to-large, sturdy yet graceful build; the tail is thick and carried high, often forming a characteristic plume or curl.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the immaculate, voluminous white coat and the specific high carriage of the tail plume.

attributes.head_and_ears: Strong, proportionate head structure with a defined muzzle of moderate length. Ears are typically small and set high on the skull, often semi-pricked or close to the head.
attributes.eyes: Deeply set, dark brown eyes characterized by an alert and intelligent expression.
attributes.coat: A dense, harsh, wiry double coat. The texture is coarse and bristly, composed of tightly packed guard hairs over a softer undercoat. Colors are typically rich reds, browns, or wheaten tones.
attributes.body: Compact, muscular, and low-slung frame. The body exhibits a sturdy balance appropriate to its size, maintaining a level carriage.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of the extremely dense, harsh texture of the wiry coat and the robustly compact skeletal structure.

attributes.head_and_ears: Wedge-shaped skull structure with a proportionate, moderate muzzle length; ears are sharply pointed, erect, and triangular.
attributes.eyes: Almond-shaped orbits containing deep amber to dark brown irises, conveying alertness and intelligence.
attributes.coat: Dense double coat; the outer guard hairs are short, smooth, and lie close to the body, providing a sleek visual profile; colors include solid reds, blacks, and sesame tones.
attributes.body: Compact, muscular, and balanced frame; the tail is carried high and exhibits a characteristic tight curl over the loin.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The combination of the clean, chiseled facial lines and the specific, tightly coiled carriage of the tail.

attributes.head_and_ears: Defined wedge-shaped skull structure, chiseled muzzle, and large, erect triangular ears set high on the cranium.
attributes.eyes: Vivid sapphire blue, almond-shaped, providing a high degree of visual contrast with the coat.
attributes.coat: Extremely short, fine texture. The body exhibits a pale base color (cream/ivory), while the extremities develop sharply defined, hyperpigmented points in rich seal brown or sable tones.
attributes.body: Slender, elegant, and muscular frame with a graceful gait. The tail is long and tapering, maintaining the body's linear profile.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The crisp, high-contrast demarcation line between the pale body coat and the dark, intensely pigmented points, which is characteristic of the colorpoint pattern.

attributes.head_and_ears: Wedge-shaped cranium with a defined muzzle; ears are proportionate, erect, and finely tapered.
attributes.eyes: Large orbital prominence with a wide aperture; coloration is typically intense (e.g., amber, gold, or vivid green), providing high contrast against the skin.
attributes.coat: Visually characterized by the absence of a dense pelage; the surface presents as smooth, pliable skin texture with visible micro-folds and wrinkles.
attributes.body: Compact, muscular physique; the torso exhibits a taut yet yielding quality due to underlying musculature and loose epidermal folds, particularly around the neck and flanks.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of the highly elastic, wrinkled epidermal layer and the pronounced underlying skeletal musculature, visible through the lack of insulating fur.

attributes.head_and_ears: Broad, powerful skull structure; moderate muzzle length proportionate to the head; ears are typically semi-pricked or close-fitting to the skull.
attributes.eyes: Deep, dark brown iris; alert and expressive gaze with a medium-sized orbital structure.
attributes.coat: Short, dense, and smooth double coat; texture is sleek and tight against the body; coloration varies but often presents in fawn, red, or brin patterns.
attributes.body: Compact, muscular, and sturdy build; low-slung torso with visible muscle definition beneath the coat; tail is typically short and set close to the body.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The extreme density and definition of the musculature, which gives the animal a powerful, blocky silhouette despite its moderate size.

attributes.head_and_ears: Moderately sized, well-chiseled skull structure; muzzle is strong and proportionate to the cranium. Ears are typically set high and semi-erect, maintaining a clean profile.
attributes.eyes: Deeply set eyes exhibiting a rich amber to dark brown hue; the shape is alert and almond-like, conveying high visual acuity.
attributes.coat: A dense double coat characterized by a fine-grained texture. The color is uniformly saturated golden yellow (wheaten), often exhibiting subtle tan tipping on the extremities, providing visual depth.
attributes.body: Compact and muscular build with balanced proportions. The torso is sturdy, supporting a gait that appears agile and purposeful. Tail carriage is typically level or slightly elevated.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique, consistent saturation and warmth of the golden coat color across the entire body mass, which provides a striking visual contrast against the underlying musculature and bone structure.

attributes.head_and_ears: Small, finely chiseled head structure with a tapering muzzle; ears are small, erect, and set high on the skull.
attributes.eyes: Dark, highly reflective eyes with an almond to round shape, conveying alertness and expressiveness.
attributes.coat: A dense, single-layer coat characterized by a remarkably fine, silky texture. The coloration typically exhibits distinct bands of steel blue-gray and rich tan/gold tipping.
attributes.body: Small, delicate, and gracefully proportioned body build; the tail is typically carried high and often forms a plume or gentle curl.
attributes.distinguishing_mark: The unique combination of the compact, elegant cranial structure and the exceptionally fine-grained, flowing coat that maintains its specific blue/tan chromatic pattern.
